slides.title: The first *30 seconds* decide the other thirty minutes
replace: SUBJECT: a screaming mouth wide open, teeth blown to pure white.
COMPOSITION: the mouth fills the upper right; the lower-left third is solid black.
COLOUR: the starburst overlay is hot magenta.
SUBJECT: a lone figure walking away, tiny, seen from behind.
COMPOSITION: the figure sits small and high; a vast black field fills the lower two thirds.
COLOUR: the starburst overlay is deep orange-red.

slides.title: Nobody stays for the *warm-up*
replace: SUBJECT: a mouth pressed shut, lips tight, jaw clenched.
COMPOSITION: the mouth crosses the upper half; the bottom-left is solid black.
COLOUR: the starburst overlay is electric blue-violet.
SUBJECT: a hand clamped over an ear.
COMPOSITION: the hand fills the top-right corner; the rest is blown to white paper.
COLOUR: the starburst overlay is acid lime yellow-green.

slides.title: Move your best line to the *top*
replace: SUBJECT: two fingers holding a thin blade against a strip of tape.
COMPOSITION: the fingers enter from the top-right; the lower-left is empty black.
COLOUR: the starburst overlay is acid lime yellow-green.

slides.title: Start at the *punchline*
replace: SUBJECT: a throat and jaw tipped back, tendons standing out.
COMPOSITION: the throat runs down the right third; the left two thirds are blown white.
COLOUR: the starburst overlay is hot pink.

slides.title: Six tools, *one* pass
replace: SUBJECT: a close crop of heavily crumpled paper filling the frame, photocopied down to pure black and white.
COMPOSITION: the crumple catches light in the upper right; the lower two thirds fall away to near-solid black.
COLOUR: the starburst overlay is small, in the top-right corner only.

slides.title: Your cold open, found for you
replace: SUBJECT: an eye held wide open, lashes breaking into dots.
COMPOSITION: the eye sits high and right; the lower half is solid black.
COLOUR: the starburst overlay is acid lime yellow-green.
